queries: select supplier_id, date_trunc('week',order_date) wk, round(avg(is_late::int),2) lr, round(avg(delay_days),1) d from purchase_order where supplier_id<>'SUP-001' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select order_date, count(*) n, round(avg(is_late::int),2) lr, round(avg(delay_days),1) d from purchase_order where supplier_id='SUP-001' and order_date between '2025-02-24' and '2025-03-14' group by 1 order by 1
select p.supplier_id, date_trunc('week',l.date) wk, count(*) lost from lost_sale l join product p on p.id=l.product_id group by 1,2 order by 2,1
select supplier_id, date_trunc('week',date) wk, count(*) c from complaint group by 1,2 order by 2,1
